messages.body:
day 6 of studying abroad:
a pretty plain friday to say the least
didnt went to the lectures today cuz i wanted to take the day off for recovering
went to do the laundry today, went pretty good, my clothes are now finally not in scarcity again <:aga:1531611868798652510>
I went and cooked rice by myself, this time trying the "finger technique", and i'd say the rice were pretty fluffy and not bad to eat :>
my flatmate was cooking steak and veggies, but he forgor to open the cooker hood <:skulk:1534514985487565020> and made the smoke alarm go off <:kekw:778988866228453437>
the smoke alarm was ringing for a solid 10 mins or so, alerting all blocks and even got some of the residents to actually leave the building to get to safety area.
the ppl next to our flat came over and figured out the situation, and we made some good connections from this interaction (so thanks flatmate i guess?)
after the steak meal (which i forgot to take a picture of), i went to the village bar and took a snap of their menu. I also tried their 1quid shot and damn that felt nice 
my 1st time ever ordering anything at a pub, although prices are not as expected to be fair, was overhyped by scholars claiming that guinness was dirt cheap <:skulk:1534514985487565020>
anywho had a great time there.
when i walked back to the flat with my flatmate, we saw our other flatmate inside our neighbors flatmate <:kekw:778988866228453437> so we snuck in too and stayed our welcome
we had lots of talks and chat, and i ended up staying for their "movie night" (it was more like a tv show but you get the idea)
I even took my monitor and used it as a "tv" for them to have a viewing experience rather than on a 13" laptop monitor <:skulk:1534514985487565020>
we watched for a solid 2.5~ hours and just finished watching, and i quite enjoyed the experience to be honest!! 
hopefully i'll get to talk to the more in the future 😋 since they are all locals (except 1 but theyre not here), they were all very easygoing
and i guess you could say i've made some friends? so yippie? <a:yippee:1514418095048101968> 

anyways heres a question for you all, there is a "hoi sem farn" + "city hunt" for 20quids, and an afterparty for another 20, making the whole set 40quids
and you can meet other HK ppl that studies in the university as well, but 40quids is not really a cheap price to pay tbh <:notyippie:1371923116921716867> 
you can afford it, but its the matter of "Will you be willing to pay 40 quids to meet hk ppls and widen your circle of friends?" i guess
lemme know with reactions!! :D day 5 signing off
oh and spoiler alert, but i might be able to get the ctf team here in uob to play HKCERT CTF 👀 but not with me of course 😭

Day 4 of studying abroad
Today was fun, went to try a 3.50 pizza roll in coop, shit was kinda nice but the outer crust is <:ew:1370242377133981749> 
talked to my flatmate during him cooking lunch, and told him idk what to eat for dinner
he said he could cook for me <:cat_stare_happy:1388215465494446221> 
so for dinner my flatmate cooked a pot of noodles and onions and pork and chicken drumstick and other stuff
was very nice
another flatmate bought 50p pizza from aldi and told me to try it
for 50p it was not bad, but we need an air fryer asap
later I'll be going to chinatown with @\bugpus, so hopefully we dont get robbed <:kekw:778988866228453437>
1st time sleeping <8hrs here. lets hope i can wake up :>
alright day 4 out.

Some images from today :D

Day 5 of studying abroad:
I had lots of fun today (although very tired)
@bugpus decided to visit me today all the way from manchester (he thought i was gonna kms)
and we decided to go to chinatown and buy rice cooker to make dinner
Images are not in order but I'll try to cover all of them
last picture is my current setup! I finally got a monitor stand from amazon and installed my monitor!!
it looks absolutely gorgeous to see my monitor here and not have to use the tiny 16" monitor 🥀 
and also that the transport of the monitor didnt broke it makes me very happy! :D
the bike picture is my first time riding a lime bike (my first time for electric bike too!) and omg...
the startup speed is soooo quick I legit had longitudinal g force when I start pedalling <:skulk:1534514985487565020>
but it was so fun!! the whole bike ride was like a motorcycle except with pedals
The fried rice pic above was the meal we had. Actually good fried rice 😋
then we saw some cool photo of yellow colored masked dude under an umbrella... totally doesnt mean anything :> (gfhk!)
and i saw cathay street, which js reminded me to cathay pacific
and biang biang noodle! the infamous "most strokes in a chinese character" letter noodle :p i don't even know how they managed to print the letter at all <:kekw:778988866228453437>
next is the arcade machine... this has to be a aliexpress-ahh maimai machine with 6 buttons instead of 8 <:kekw:778988866228453437> it was so funny but we didn't try it cuz the arcade looks dead asf
lastly is the meal! we ended up buying a lot of condiments, food, rice, and cooked a meal for both of us back in my dorm
the funny thing is... the most notable thing about me is idk how to cook, cuz i never acted on it (except instant noodles)
and @bugpus was even worse <:cat_stare_happy:1388215465494446221> every item i prepped was fine and looks nice, including the chickens and the carrots (yes those are carrots)
but the rice that he did... lets just say the cashier said the rice cooker we bought cannot cook congee, and @bugpus took offence of that <:skulk:1534514985487565020>
it was literally sticky rice, cuz he added too much water... but the steamed egg turned out okay-ish, so i'll let it slide
at the end he had to go early to catch the train, and left me to do all the dishes... it took me 3 quarters of an hour (around 10 songs) to finish cleaning the entire kitchen...
only to then have his train be delayed 45+ mins :>
anyways today was an eventful day, bought many stuff, im going broke, please send money via fps please please please <:blobcatpray:1081191794441736244>
I forgot day 3 again
some nice photo :D

Day 3 was fine
I went to lesson, had lunch with my friend, took him to my dorm and look around, then walk 40 mins to supermarket and 10 more min to go even further -v-
my total step for ytd was 25k... i think i would never walk that much in my life if i'm in hk
I went to buy hangers, clippers, dehumidifier box, some other personal stuff
was a fun day to say the least
today i'll just chill in my dorm and maybe eat some rubbish food <:kekw:778988866228453437>

i forgot about writing day 2 <:skulk:1534514985487565020>
too tired, mentally drained, 
walked 45 mins to the nearest market, carried 4kg of grocery back to dorm
walked for another hour (uphill btw)
total steps was 22.3k ytd, my watch told me to rest 13+ hours
really wanna leave already, does not enjoy the feeling of going to places alone (autophobia)

end up going to a society night, where they introduce various compsci related societies
found that there was a ctf team here in uob, and they host in-person mini ctf sometimes,
they know my existence apparently (kinda shocked), so we chat alot about ctf stuff and upcoming workshop possibly providing some challenge for them to use.
there was also many cool societies, but im gonna look around first for now.

anyway day 3 today, hope i can stay sane and stay here longer. 
ps i already skipped a lecture ytd because i went grocery shopping
psps i mightve bought the worst groceries i could ever get. its a lottery to buy things there since theres so many variations for NO FUCKING REASON.
pspsps today will be a break day, i'll js do nothing and chill for a bit, ytd was such a fucked day i genuinely died inside
yay stickers
and have friend cook for me
大廚級數 (gordon ramsey)

day 1 of me studying abroad:
I feel like I need this channel to keep me sane. you can mute the channel if its boring.
1st time in my life travelling this far from home, and alone too
felt like I underpacked a lot of things, and had to buy a lot of stuff to recover (very financially unstable)
the plane meals were alright, the vibes werent highest in the airport, but I survived i guess
arriving in UK feels like im js travelling, having 2 other UK friends (thanks @\thomaswong123 and @wknd_og) to pick me up was fun
we hung out, went up and down the hill, went to city center, my first time taking a bus, trying wingstop
it was quality time, i enjoyed it
but there are still ~270 days to live through, and as a broke student, this is going to be difficult
I hope I can finish buying the necessities and live to see until mid oct for a payment
dont really miss home yet, cuz i never had any sense of belonging in it except my computer corner
but maybe in the future i'll feel different, so who knows?
anyways tmr i'll have my first tutorial and lecture, + an event with comp sci soc, perhaps i'll find time to purchases the things i need :>
still cant get over no filtering the water before drinking <:skulk:1534514985487565020>
my first tutorial!
everyone cant connect to sch's eduroam (except me for some reason) <:kekw:917496715957919834>
can i start a gofundme and have you guys pay me some money for my living (only for a week)
walking 40 mins for a supermarket
update: walked 45 to the nearest supermarket, bought stuff for 20 mins (cuz their scanning thing sucks), missed a lecture, walked back with 4kgs of groceries for 50 mins
i still dont have bowls, plates or knifes
